page.layout: One narrow column of index entries down the left side of the scan, in black letter, with a blue-highlighted entry "to Mu..." near the middle. No running head, page number, catchword or signature visible.; One narrow strip of an index: at the top a large letter I in a blue box; then two columns of index entries with blue page references running down the right side; in the left margin single letters N, O, P set as section letters, with entries beside them.; One column of index entries with page references at the left (blue-highlighted numbers), running head "INDEX" at top; entries in black letter, lines set with a vertical rule between page references and headwords.; One narrow column of page references at the right edge of the scan, with a few catchwords and index words at the left edge (partly cut off); the rest of the page is not shown.
page.notes: Black letter throughout; initial capitals are decorated and some entries are read with [?] because the letters are worn. The blue highlight on "to" is a digitiser's mark on the scan and is not transcribed as text. Lines below "to Pe" are partly cut off at the bottom edge of this part. The strip is cropped at the left and right edges, so many entries are cut short. Blue boxes and underlined blue numbers are reference marks, copied as printed where legible. Entries read only in part are cut off by the scan edge and are not completed. Headwords in black letter; the initial letters of several words are large black-letter capitals and were read as the printed forms (P/B for the Gothic P, D for Dualme/Dueante/Duena). Final words cut off at the right edge of the scan are given as far as legible. Page references are printed in blue-highlighted boxes and are copied as printed. Some words at the right edge (e.g. "Blash: t", "to Bzate") are truncated by the scan edge. Left-hand words are cut off at the scan edge (for example "plasthy", "oge", "oine"); only the right-hand references are fully legible. Several entries are highlighted in blue and underlined, and one small mark "1" appears beside the first reference, which is not transcribed. The page number and running head are not visible in this part.
